intent_summary: Timestamped observations are normalized to UTC, ordered, and checked against their declared cadence before analysis.

criteria.criterion: Timestamped datasets provide both timestamps and frequency; positional datasets provide neither.
Local timestamps require a timezone, and ambiguous or nonexistent daylight-saving times require an explicit offset.
Duplicate timestamps are rejected unless an aggregation policy is supplied; duplicate counts and transformations remain visible.
An as_of cutoff excludes later observations, and cadence is checked as a fixed elapsed duration.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Inspected UTC normalization, sorted/duplicate/cutoff transformations and resolved API context; cross-interface context tests establish a 71-observation cutoff.
